title: MWS — RESURVEY_8YR table
description: Array of Million Women Study 8-year ('lilac') resurvey records. One element is one participant's 8-year follow-up record.
$comment: This table has no participant-identifier field in the source dictionary at all, same as the other two tables (open item, see DECISIONS.md D007/D047) -- uniqueItems is asserted as standing structural policy but cannot anchor to a real key here, and there is currently no way to link a resurvey_8yr row back to its recruitment or resurvey_3yr row for the same participant.

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern: never used HRT means type, duration, and time-since-last-used are structurally not applicable -- D090, mirrors the confirmed pattern from recruitment (D039) and resurvey_3yr (D052). Deliberately does NOT include F2HTNPC=4 ('Ever, status not known') -- steward-confirmed to stay unconstrained, D090.
Applicability: a participant who has ever used HRT (Past or Current) must have real values for type and duration -- D090.
HRT routing: a participant currently using HRT has not stopped, so time-since-last-used is structurally not applicable -- D090.
Applicability: a participant who stopped using HRT in the past must have a real value for time-since-last-used -- D090.

Skip pattern: the steward gave the real printed instruction directly -- 'If you have less than one drink a week, please go to question 60' -- so F2ALCNUM=0 means the with-meals and days-per-week follow-ups are structurally not applicable -- D092. Genuinely different from resurvey_3yr's F1ALCNUM (D058, confirmed no skip there) -- not transplanted.

Applicability: a participant who drinks at least one drink per week (real value other than 0, including the 97/99 unknown-amount codes) must have real answers for the with-meals and days-per-week questions -- D092.

Skip pattern: F2CIGSPD's own question wording is explicitly applicable to both current AND past smokers -- 'how many do/did you smoke... if ex-smoker, when you smoked'. A Never answer means cigarettes-per-day is structurally not applicable -- D093. A different shape from recruitment's D035 (no skip) and resurvey_3yr's D062 (Never-only skip, but confirmed independently, not transplanted here).
Applicability: a participant who has ever smoked (Past or Current) must have a real answer for cigarettes-per-day, per the question's own wording covering both -- D093.
